Author: KeydenK
Name: Hats Off
Punchline: Automatically hides your headgear during cutscenes and, if you like, story conversations.
Description:
Hides your headgear while a cutscene plays and puts it back the moment it ends. Nothing is sent to the game server: other players keep seeing your hat.

It works from the very start of each cutscene, including on the copy of your character used in story scenes, and always puts your own hat setting back exactly as it was. Choose story cutscenes, duty cutscenes or both, and optionally hide it during quest and NPC conversations (vendors and retainers are left alone) or when a quest makes your character react, like bowing, kneeling or reaching out (simple pickups keep your hat on).

If you use a sync plugin (Lightless Sync, PlayerSync...), people synced with you may briefly see it after a cutscene, and during NPC conversations and quest interactions if those options are on. Requires Glamourer (which itself requires Penumbra). Command: /hatsoff
Changelog: New: quest objects and quest animations only hide your hat when your character visibly reacts (reaching out, kneeling, a facial expression...), so simple pickups no longer make it blink (experimental option for quest animations). Vendors and service NPCs no longer hide your hat with the NPC conversation option. No more flashing between the parts of a conversation, with a new 'Keep hidden after a conversation' setting. Clearer description, and a note about sync plugins (Lightless Sync, PlayerSync).
